hypotheses.title: Batch 75: Tri-Candidate Precision Breakout (Calibrated Yield & Timing Convergence)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Applies the Tri-Candidate Batch Protocol (Batch Size Invariant: exactly 3 candidates) directly leveraging Batch 74 findings: (1) Cash Flow Per Share Yield with 1-Year CapEx Reinvestment Return on Assets in TOP1000 Subindustry Neutral. (2) Consensus Adjusted Net Income Yield with 60-Day Analyst EPS Revision Velocity and 5-Day Liquidity Timing Entry in TOP2000 Industry Neutral (elevating Candidate 2 from Sharpe 0.96 to >1.65). (3) Institutional 3-Year LEAP Call Term Structure coupled with 30-Day Variance Risk Premium Fading and Price Delta in TOPSP500 Sector Neutral (eliminating unit warnings and elevating Candidate 3 from Sharpe 1.12 to Spectacular).
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if fundamental yields or options variance premia deteriorate under subindustry/sector neutralization during monetary policy inflections.
